subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <climits> header. SHIPPED 2026-08-25. A macro-only module: every name it provides is a preprocessor macro, so it contributes NO re_std:: symbols at all -- unlike <cstddef>, which has a typedef half. What it contributes instead is availability. The C++11 long long macro set is filled in from the compiler's own __LONG_LONG_MAX__ builtin where the platform's header predates it, and every gap-fill is #ifndef-guarded, so a complete platform header is never overridden. For anything outside a preprocessor conditional, re_std::numeric_limits<T> from <limits> is the better answer: typed, namespaced, constexpr, and uniform across the floating-point types, which have no macro equivalent here at all.
legend_blurb: <climits> provides the integer limit macros (CHAR_BIT, the SCHAR / SHRT / INT / LONG / LLONG limits, MB_LEN_MAX).

symbols.name: CHAR_BIT
symbols.notes: Bits in a byte. Macros have no namespace, so there is no re_std:: spelling and none is invented. re_std's contribution is availability: the umbrella guarantees the macro is in scope, and the module fills it in from a compiler builtin where the platform's own header predates it. Every gap-fill is #ifndef-guarded -- a platform that answered is never overridden.

symbols.name: CHAR_MIN / CHAR_MAX
symbols.notes: The signedness of plain char is implementation-defined, so CHAR_MIN is 0 on some targets and SCHAR_MIN on others. Do not assume. symbols.name: LLONG_MIN / LLONG_MAX / ULLONG_MAX
symbols.notes: C++11 additions, and the module's one real portability contribution: compilers that support long long as an extension on an older library ship the type WITHOUT the macros. re_std recovers them from the compiler's own __LONG_LONG_MAX__ builtin -- a re-derivation, not a guess, since the compiler is the authority on its own type's width. LLONG_MIN is derived as -LLONG_MAX - 1 rather than written as a literal: the token -9223372036854775808 is a unary minus on a literal too large for a signed type. Where even the builtin is absent nothing is defined, leaving an omission the caller can #ifdef for rather than a wrong value they cannot detect. RE_STD AHEAD OF STD in reach: available at C++98 tiers where the platform header lacks them.

symbols.name: MB_LEN_MAX
symbols.notes: Longest multibyte character across all locales. Gap-filled at 16 only on a freestanding library that omitted it -- an over-estimate of every implementation the authors know of (glibc 16, MSVC 5, musl 4), and over-estimating is the safe direction: the macro's job is to size a buffer. Distinct from <cstdlib>'s MB_CUR_MAX, which is the CURRENT locale's maximum; buffers want this one.
